Lake Winnipesaukee: New Hampshire Lake Fishing

Make Lake Winnipesaukee your New Hampshire fishing stop. Choose a trolling trip or time on shore and enjoy a day by the lake.

About this water

The fishery source record for Lake Winnipesaukee, United States, identifies Smallmouth bass, Largemouth bass and Lake trout.

At Winnipesaukee, compare a lake-trout boat program with a bass or shore program as separate choices. Ask the provider to identify the departure area and the equipment needed for the selected presentation. The lake's managed-fishery record supports the species context, not current access or a charter inventory. Confirm what stays aboard before packing a trolling outfit. A shoreline alternative should have its own target agreement if the original plan changes.
